description: This script contains a series of automated tests for verifying the behavior of Git push commands, particularly focusing on options like --all, --branches, --tags, --mirror, --delete, and --follow-tags. It sets up test repositories, performs push operations with different options, and compares expected ref states to actual results to ensure command correctness.

methods.name: delete_refs
methods.description: Deletes specified references in a given directory by creating a list of refs to delete and updating the refs via stdin.
